source.description: Convert between currencies using the latest published reference rate, or enter a rate manually.

explanations.formula: Received amount = amount × exchange rate × (1 − provider fee percentage)
steps: Use the latest published reference rate when available, or the manually entered rate.
Multiply the source amount by the exchange rate to get the gross converted value.
Calculate the provider fee as a percentage of the gross converted value.
Subtract the fee to estimate the amount received.
Reference rates are not guaranteed bank or card quotes.
disclaimers: Reference rates are not guaranteed bank or card quotes.

source.description: Estimate monthly principal and interest, total borrowing cost and balance trend.

explanations.formula: P = home price − down payment; PMT = P·i / (1 − (1+i)⁻ⁿ)
steps: Financed principal equals home price minus down payment.
Monthly rate i equals annual rate divided by 1200; n equals years multiplied by 12.
For a positive rate, calculate the fixed payment; at zero rate, payment equals P divided by n.
Monthly interest equals opening balance multiplied by i; principal equals payment minus interest.
Apply any extra principal payment and aggregate monthly rows into years.
disclaimers: Fixed-rate or periodic estimates depend on the entered assumptions.

explanations.formula: PMT = P·i / (1 − (1+i)⁻ⁿ); extra payment is applied to principal after scheduled payment

Calculate the fixed payment from principal and term.

Apply the scheduled payment and any extra payment; principal is payment minus interest.
Continue until payoff and aggregate monthly rows into yearly totals.
